chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā ibn ʿUbayd, from Muḥammad ibn Shuʿayb, from ʿImrān ibn Isḥāq al-Zaʿfarānī, from Muḥammad ibn Marwān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I heard him saying: “Indeed, Allah created us from the light of His magnificence, then He formed our creation from treasured, concealed clay from beneath the Throne. Then He settled that light within it, so we became a creation and luminous human beings. He did not grant anyone any share in the like of that from which He created us.”

And He created the souls of our Shiʿah from our clay, and their bodies from treasured, concealed clay lower than that clay. And Allah did not grant anyone any share in the like of that from which He created them, except the Prophets. Therefore, we and they became the people, while the rest of the people became rabble for the Fire, and unto the Fire.”

key_terms.أَبْدَانَهُمْ: their bodies, distinguished from their souls in the account of creation
key_terms.أَرْوَاحَ شِيعَتِنَا: the souls of the Shiʿah, described here as created from the clay of the Imams عليهم السلام
key_terms.النَّارِ: the Fire, the final destination mentioned for the rest of the people in the narration
key_terms.الْأَنْبِيَاءِ: the Prophets, who are excepted in sharing in a similar created distinction
key_terms.الْعَرْشِ: the Throne, indicating an exalted and metaphysical place in the narration
key_terms.طِينَةٍ مَخْزُونَةٍ مَكْنُونَةٍ: treasured and concealed clay specially reserved in the account of creation
key_terms.نُورِ عَظَمَتِهِ: the divine light of Allah’s magnificence from which the Imams عليهم السلام are said to have been created
key_terms.هَمَجًا: rabble or undifferentiated masses, used here for the rest of the people

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith in al-Kāfī say about the creation of the Imams عليهم السلام and the souls of their Shiʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the creation of the Imams عليهم السلام as originating from the light of divine magnificence and from a special concealed clay beneath the Throne. It also states that the souls of their Shiʿah were created from their clay, distinguishing them spiritually from others and framing this distinction in relation to the Prophets and the final destiny of people.
